verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγγίζουσιν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα εἰς Βηθφαγὴ καὶ Βηθανίαν πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν ἀποστέλλει δύο τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai hote engizousin eis Hierosolyma eis Bēthphagē kai Bēthanian pros to oros tōn Elaiōn apostellei dyo tōn mathētōn autou
verses.literal: As they approached . . . Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives Jesus sent out two of His disciples
verses.literalPt: E, LOGO que se aproximaram de Jerusalém, de Betfagé e de Betânia, junto do Monte das Oliveiras, enviou dois dos seus discípulos,

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν κώμην τὴν κατέναντι ὑμῶν καὶ εὐθὺς εἰσπορευόμενοι εἰς αὐτὴν εὑρήσετε πῶλον δεδεμένον ἐφ’ ὃν οὐδεὶς οὔπω ἀνθρώπων ἐκάθισεν λύσατε αὐτὸν καὶ φέρετε
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Hypagete eis tēn kōmēn tēn katenanti hymōn kai euthys eisporeuomenoi eis autēn heurēsete pōlon dedemenon eph’ hon oudeis oupō anthrōpōn ekathisen lysate auton kai pherete
verses.literal: and said to them Go into the village ahead of you and as soon as you enter . . . it you will find a colt tied there on which no one . . . has ever sat Untie it and bring it here
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Ide à aldeia que está defronte de vós; e, logo que ali entrardes, encontrareis preso um jumentinho, sobre o qual ainda não montou homem algum; soltai-o, e trazei-mo.

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ Τί ποιεῖτε τοῦτο εἴπατε Ὅτι Ὁ Κύριος αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχει καὶ εὐθὺς αὐτὸν ἀποστέλλει πάλιν ὧδε
verses.transliteration: kai ean tis hymin eipē Ti poieite touto eipate Hoti HO Kyrios autou chreian echei kai euthys auton apostellei palin hōde
verses.literal: If anyone asks Why are you doing this tell him The Lord needs it and will return . . . . . . it shortly
verses.literalPt: E, se alguém vos disser: Por que fazeis isso? dizei-lhe que o Senhor precisa dele, e logo o deixará trazer para aqui.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπῆλθον καὶ εὗρον πῶλον δεδεμένον πρὸς θύραν ἔξω ἐπὶ τοῦ ἀμφόδου καὶ λύουσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai apēlthon kai heuron pōlon dedemenon pros thyran exō epi tou amphodou kai lyousin auton
verses.literal: So they went and found the colt outside in the street tied at a doorway They untied it
verses.literalPt: E foram, e encontraram o jumentinho preso fora da porta, entre dois caminhos, e o soltaram.

verses.original: καί τινες τῶν ἐκεῖ ἑστηκότων ἔλεγον αὐτοῖς Τί ποιεῖτε λύοντες τὸν πῶλον
verses.transliteration: kai tines tōn ekei hestēkotōn elegon autois Ti poieite lyontes ton pōlon
verses.literal: and some who were standing there asked . . . Why are you untying the colt
verses.literalPt: E alguns dos que ali estavam lhes disseram: Que fazeis, soltando o jumentinho?

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς καθὼς εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἀφῆκαν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan autois kathōs eipen ho Iēsous kai aphēkan autous
verses.literal: The disciples answered . . . as Jesus had instructed them and the people gave them permission . . .
verses.literalPt: Eles, porém, disseram-lhes como Jesus lhes tinha mandado; e deixaram-nos ir.

verses.original: καὶ φέρουσιν τὸν πῶλον πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐπιβάλλουσιν αὐτῷ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai pherousin ton pōlon pros ton Iēsoun kai epiballousin autō ta himatia autōn kai ekathisen ep’ auton
verses.literal: Then they led the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it and He sat on it
verses.literalPt: E levaram o jumentinho a Jesus, e lançaram sobre ele as suas vestes, e assentou-se sobre ele.

verses.original: Καὶ πολλοὶ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν ἔστρωσαν εἰς τὴν ὁδόν ἄλλοι δὲ στιβάδας κόψαντες ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai polloi ta himatia autōn estrōsan eis tēn hodon alloi de stibadas kopsantes ek tōn agrōn
verses.literal: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road while others spread branches they had cut from the fields
verses.literalPt: E muitos estendiam as suas vestes pelo caminho, e outros cortavam ramos das árvores, e os espalhavam pelo caminho.

verses.original: καὶ οἱ προάγοντες καὶ οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἔκραζον Ὡσαννά Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: kai hoi proagontes kai hoi akolouthountes ekrazon Hōsanna Eulogēmenos ho erchomenos en onomati Kyriou
verses.literal: The ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting Hosanna Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord
verses.literalPt: E aqueles que iam adiante, e os que seguiam, clamavam, dizendo: Hosana, bendito o que vem em nome do Senhor;

verses.original: Εὐλογημένη ἡ ἐρχομένη βασιλεία τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Δαυίδ Ὡσαννὰ ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις
verses.transliteration: Eulogēmenē hē erchomenē basileia tou patros hēmōn Dauid Hōsanna en tois hypsistois
verses.literal: Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David Hosanna in the highest
verses.literalPt: Bendito o reino do nosso pai Davi, que vem em nome do Senhor. Hosana nas alturas.

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα εἰς τὸ ἱερόν καὶ περιβλεψάμενος πάντα ὀψὲ ἤδη οὔσης τῆς ὥρας ἐξῆλθεν εἰς Βηθανίαν μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: Kai eisēlthen eis Hierosolyma eis to hieron kai periblepsamenos panta opse ēdē ousēs tēs hōras exēlthen eis Bēthanian meta tōn dōdeka
verses.literal: Then Jesus entered . . . Jerusalem and went into the temple courts He looked around at everything but since it was already late He went out to Bethany with the Twelve
verses.literalPt: E Jesus entrou em Jerusalém, no templo, e, tendo visto tudo em redor, como fosse já tarde, saiu para Betânia com os doze.

verses.original: Καὶ τῇ ἐπαύριον ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Βηθανίας ἐπείνασεν
verses.transliteration: Kai tē epaurion exelthontōn autōn apo Bēthanias epeinasen
verses.literal: The next day when they had left . . . Bethany Jesus was hungry
verses.literalPt: E, no dia seguinte, quando saíram de Betânia, teve fome.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδὼν συκῆν ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἔχουσαν φύλλα ἦλθεν εἰ ἄρα τι εὑρήσει ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐπ’ αὐτὴν οὐδὲν εὗρεν εἰ μὴ φύλλα ὁ γὰρ καιρὸς οὐκ ἦν σύκων
verses.transliteration: kai idōn sykēn apo makrothen echousan phylla ēlthen ei ara ti heurēsei en autē kai elthōn ep’ autēn ouden heuren ei mē phylla ho gar kairos ouk ēn sykōn
verses.literal: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf He went to see if there was any fruit on it But when He reached . . . it He found nothing on it except . . . leaves since it was not the season for figs
verses.literalPt: E, vendo de longe uma figueira que tinha folhas, foi ver se nela acharia alguma coisa; e, chegando a ela, não achou senão folhas, porque não era tempo de figos.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῇ Μηκέτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐκ σοῦ μηδεὶς καρπὸν φάγοι καὶ ἤκουον οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai apokritheis eipen autē Mēketi eis ton aiōna ek sou mēdeis karpon phagoi kai ēkouon hoi mathētai autou
verses.literal: Then He said to the tree May no one ever . . . . . . . . . eat of your fruit again And His disciples heard this statement
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, falando, disse à figueira: Nunca mais coma alguém fruto de ti. E os seus discípulos ouviram isto.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα Καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἤρξατο ἐκβάλλειν τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ τοὺς ἀγοράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ τὰς τραπέζας τῶν κολλυβιστῶν καὶ τὰς καθέδρας τῶν πωλούντων τὰς περιστερὰς κατέστρεψεν
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai eis Hierosolyma Kai eiselthōn eis to hieron ērxato ekballein tous pōlountas kai tous agorazontas en tō hierō kai tas trapezas tōn kollybistōn kai tas kathedras tōn pōlountōn tas peristeras katestrepsen
verses.literal: When they arrived in Jerusalem Jesus entered . . . the temple courts and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves
verses.literalPt: E vieram a Jerusalém; e Jesus, entrando no templo, começou a expulsar os que vendiam e compravam no templo; e derrubou as mesas dos cambiadores e as cadeiras dos que vendiam pombas.

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν ἵνα τις διενέγκῃ σκεῦος διὰ τοῦ ἱεροῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ouk ēphien hina tis dienenkē skeuos dia tou hierou
verses.literal: And He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts
verses.literalPt: E não consentia que alguém levasse algum vaso pelo templo.

verses.original: καὶ ἐδίδασκεν καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Οὐ γέγραπται ὅτι Ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς κληθήσεται πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὑμεῖς δὲ πεποιήκατε αὐτὸν Σπήλαιον λῃστῶν
verses.transliteration: kai edidasken kai elegen autois Ou gegraptai hoti Ho oikos mou oikos proseuchēs klēthēsetai pasin tois ethnesin hymeis de pepoiēkate auton Spēlaion lēstōn
verses.literal: Then Jesus began to teach them and He declared Is it not written My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations But you have made it a den of robbers
verses.literalPt: E os ensinava, dizendo: Não está escrito: A minha casa será chamada, por todas as nações, casa de oração? Mas vós a tendes feito covil de ladrões.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ ἐζήτουν πῶς αὐτὸν ἀπολέσωσιν ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ αὐτόν πᾶς γὰρ ὁ ὄχλος ἐξεπλήσσετο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai ēkousan hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis kai ezētoun pōs auton apolesōsin ephobounto gar auton pas gar ho ochlos exeplēsseto epi tē didachē autou
verses.literal: When the chief priests and scribes heard this they looked for a way to kill Him For they were afraid of Him because the whole crowd was astonished at His teaching
verses.literalPt: E os escribas e príncipes dos sacerdotes, tendo ouvido isto, buscavam ocasião para o matar; pois eles o temiam, porque toda a multidão estava admirada acerca da sua doutrina.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν ὀψὲ ἐγένετο ἐξεπορεύοντο ἔξω τῆς πόλεως
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan opse egeneto exeporeuonto exō tēs poleōs
verses.literal: And when evening came Jesus and His disciples went out of the city
verses.literalPt: E, sendo já tarde, saiu para fora da cidade.

verses.original: Καὶ παραπορευόμενοι πρωῒ εἶδον τὴν συκῆν ἐξηραμμένην ἐκ ῥιζῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai paraporeuomenoi prōi eidon tēn sykēn exērammenēn ek rhizōn
verses.literal: As they were walking back in the morning they saw the fig tree withered from its roots
verses.literalPt: E eles, passando pela manhã, viram que a figueira se tinha secado desde as raízes.

verses.original: καὶ ἀναμνησθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος λέγει αὐτῷ Ῥαββί ἴδε ἡ συκῆ ἣν κατηράσω ἐξήρανται
verses.transliteration: kai anamnēstheis ho Petros legei autō Rhabbi ide hē sykē hēn katērasō exērantai
verses.literal: Peter remembered it and said Look Rabbi The fig tree You cursed has withered
verses.literalPt: E Pedro, lembrando-se, disse-lhe: Mestre, eis que a figueira, que tu amaldiçoaste, se secou.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἔχετε πίστιν θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho Iēsous legei autois Echete pistin theou
verses.literal: Have faith in God - Jesus said to them
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Tende fé em Deus;

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ Ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ μὴ διακριθῇ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ πιστεύῃ ὅτι ὃ λαλεῖ γίνεται ἔσται αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti hos an eipē tō orei toutō Arthēti kai blēthēti eis tēn thalassan kai mē diakrithē en tē kardia autou alla pisteuē hoti ho lalei ginetai estai autō
verses.literal: Truly I tell you that if anyone . . . says to this mountain Be lifted up and thrown into the sea and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen it will be done for him
verses.literalPt: Porque em verdade vos digo que qualquer que disser a este monte: Ergue-te e lança-te no mar, e não duvidar em seu coração, mas crer que se fará aquilo que diz, tudo o que disser lhe será feito.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν πάντα ὅσα προσεύχεσθε καὶ αἰτεῖσθε πιστεύετε ὅτι ἐλάβετε καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: dia touto legō hymin panta hosa proseuchesthe kai aiteisthe pisteuete hoti elabete kai estai hymin
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I tell you whatever you ask for in prayer believe that you have received it and it will be yours
verses.literalPt: Por isso vos digo que todas as coisas que pedirdes, orando, crede receber, e tê-las-eis.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν στήκετε προσευχόμενοι ἀφίετε εἴ τι ἔχετε κατά τινος ἵνα καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἀφῇ ὑμῖν τὰ παραπτώματα ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan stēkete proseuchomenoi aphiete ei ti echete kata tinos hina kai ho Patēr hymōn ho en tois ouranois aphē hymin ta paraptōmata hymōn
verses.literal: And when you stand to pray if you hold anything against another forgive it so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well
verses.literalPt: E, quando estiverdes orando, perdoai, se tendes alguma coisa contra alguém, para que vosso Pai, que está nos céus, vos perdoe as vossas ofensas.
Mas, se vós não perdoardes, também vosso Pai, que está nos céus, vos não perdoará as vossas ofensas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται πάλιν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ περιπατοῦντος αὐτοῦ ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai palin eis Hierosolyma kai en tō hierō peripatountos autou erchontai pros auton hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis kai hoi presbyteroi
verses.literal: After their return . . . to Jerusalem . . . Jesus was walking in the temple courts and the chief priests - scribes and elders came up to Him
verses.literalPt: E tornaram a Jerusalém, e, andando ele pelo templo, os principais dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os anciãos, se aproximaram dele.

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ Ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς ἢ τίς σοι ἔδωκεν τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἵνα ταῦτα ποιῇς
verses.transliteration: kai elegon autō En poia exousia tauta poieis ē tis soi edōken tēn exousian tautēn hina tauta poiēs
verses.literal: By what authority are You doing these things they asked And who gave You the authority to do them
verses.literalPt: E lhe disseram: Com que autoridade fazes tu estas coisas? ou quem te deu tal autoridade para fazer estas coisas?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐπερωτήσω ὑμᾶς ἕνα λόγον καὶ ἀποκρίθητέ μοι καὶ ἐρῶ ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen autois Eperōtēsō hymas hena logon kai apokrithēte moi kai erō hymin en poia exousia tauta poiō
verses.literal: I will ask you one question - Jesus replied . . . and if you answer Me I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Também eu vos perguntarei uma coisa, e respondei-me; e então vos direi com que autoridade faço estas coisas:

verses.original: τὸ βάπτισμα τὸ Ἰωάννου ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἦν ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἀποκρίθητέ μοι
verses.transliteration: to baptisma to Iōannou ex ouranou ēn ē ex anthrōpōn apokrithēte moi
verses.literal: John’s baptism was it from heaven or from men Answer Me
verses.literalPt: O batismo de João era do céu ou dos homens? respondei-me.

verses.original: Καὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντες Τί εἴπωμεν Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐρεῖ Διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai dielogizonto pros heautous legontes Ti eipōmen Ean eipōmen Ex ouranou erei Dia ti oun ouk episteusate autō
verses.literal: They deliberated among themselves what they should answer If we say From heaven He will ask Why . . . then did you not believe him
verses.literalPt: E eles arrazoavam entre si, dizendo: Se dissermos: Do céu, ele nos dirá: Então por que o não crestes?

verses.original: ἀλλὰ εἴπωμεν Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἐφοβοῦντο τὸν ὄχλον ἅπαντες γὰρ εἶχον τὸν Ἰωάννην ὄντως ὅτι προφήτης ἦν
verses.transliteration: alla eipōmen Ex anthrōpōn ephobounto ton ochlon hapantes gar eichon ton Iōannēn ontōs hoti prophētēs ēn
verses.literal: But if we say From men they were afraid of the people for they all held that John truly was a prophet
verses.literalPt: Se, porém, dissermos: Dos homens, tememos o povo. Porque todos sustentavam que João verdadeiramente era profeta.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγουσιν Οὐκ οἴδαμεν Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ
verses.transliteration: kai apokrithentes tō Iēsou legousin Ouk oidamen Kai ho Iēsous legei autois Oude egō legō hymin en poia exousia tauta poiō
verses.literal: So they answered - We do not know And Jesus replied . . . Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo, disseram a Jesus: Não sabemos. E Jesus lhes replicou: Também eu vos não direi com que autoridade faço estas coisas.
